summary: Enhance your skills with our Training of Trainers in Project Management for NGOs course. Empower others while mastering essential project management techniques.
lede: Project management training for NGO trainers focuses on teaching practical project planning, delivery, and monitoring. It is for NGO professionals who train, coach, supervise, or quality-assure project teams, and supports them in turning project methods into hands-on learning. Participants practise facilitating logical framework and Theory of Change exercises, designing workplan and risk activities, and assessing learning through microteaching and monitoring tools.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for NGO professionals who train, coach, supervise, or quality-assure project teams and need a repeatable approach to teaching project management.
modules: Theory of Change and Adaptive Delivery
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to NGO projects, programme support, facilitation, monitoring and evaluation, grants, or partner capacity development. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with basic workplans, budgets, indicators, or project reporting will help you contribute effectively, while advanced Project DPro certification is not required.
